plan.notes: Sources (all official, retrieved 2026-09-30): the official Miller College of Business 'FINANCE (75 HRS.)' 4-year advising plan (Effective Fall 2023, current 2025-fall sheet, updated 05/30/2025) for all major course codes, titles, credits, prerequisites, and the suggested semester layout. Major: Business core 48 cr (ACC 201/202, BA 205, BL 260, ECON 201/202/221, FIN 300, ISOM 210/249/351, MATH 125, MCOB 100/200/300, MGT 300/491, MKG 300) + Finance core 15 cr (FIN 301/310/320/410/490) + Financial Analyst concentration 12 cr (ACC 301/302, ECON 302, FIN 445) = 75 cr. UCC (University Core Curriculum): MATH 125 satisfies Foundations math; ECON 201 Tier 1 Social Sciences; ECON 202 Tier 2; MGT 491 marked Tier 3 on the advising sheet. UCC beyond major 27 cr; free electives 18 cr; total 120. The semester arrangement follows the advising sheet's official suggested 4-year guideline. Prerequisites are transcribed from the advising sheet (e.g., MGT 491 requires senior standing plus completion of the listed business core courses; the sheet lists 'ISOM 201' among them, which does not appear as a plan course and is omitted here). This document is a suggested guideline; students must verify requirements with an advisor.
